panels.description: Lina rejects an unsafe membrane claim at a Caldera bench. Leave upper bench space.
Suri protects a living root filter from a disposal chute. Leave upper lab space.
Jalen watches a surveillance reflection in his collar mirror and hands Alex a data shard. Leave upper corridor space.
Ren opens a scorched fabrication case and inspects a repairable component. Leave upper bay space.

items.speaker: SURI
items.text: It fails if the flow is wrong. I’m taking it.

items.speaker: REN
items.text: If the small shop can’t service it, it isn’t a product.
